Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE measures Treasury volatility and term-premium stress: below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress. At 100.70 it remains moderate, despite easing. SOFR 3.88% describes secured overnight funding conditions; a 2 bp decline alone does not establish funding stress or its absence. NFCI -0.494 indicates looser broad financial conditions, slightly less loose than the revised prior week. The official 10Y yield fell 6 bp to 5.22%.

Fed & Policy Watch
Michigan preliminary consumer sentiment is today at 10 AM ET; watch inflation expectations as well as the headline. Newly posted Board events include Waller on AI Oct 13 at 3:45 AM, Bowman Oct 14 at 5:40 AM and 10:55 PM, and the Chair/IMF discussion Oct 15 at 11:30 PM, all ET. The 6-week bill has a different competitive cutoff (1 PM Oct 13) from the 13/26-week bills (11:30 AM). CPI Oct 14 and retail sales Oct 15 are High-impact catalysts. Oct 12 is a Fed holiday and SIFMA fixed-income close recommendation, while NYSE is scheduled open and CME U.S. repo closed; cross-market liquidity can thin.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check completed for Oct 9-16. CPI Oct 14 differs from PPI Oct 15; NFCI shifts to Oct 15 and petroleum inventories to Oct 15 noon. Beige Book is Oct 14 at 2 PM per the central Board, overriding Chicago's conflicting 3 PM listing. Elapsed Oct 8 events are removed.
  • BLS master schedule returned 403; inspected official CPI, PPI and import/export release pages confirm the included dates/times. Other BLS events are not inferred. DOL economic calendar was unavailable, so future jobless claims are omitted without verified date/time.
  • EIA public storage table now confirms Oct 15; official WNGSR timing is 10:30 AM ET. Its upcoming reference period is not independently confirmed. Heating-oil/propane dates were not verified and are omitted.
  • TreasuryDirect now supplies final Oct 13 6/13/26-week bill notices and times. Later auctions lacking final date/time notices are omitted rather than assigned cadence-based times. Watch bill issuance Oct 13 and bill/coupon issuance Oct 15 as date-only funding flows, not timed macro events.
  • OCC confirms monthly options expiration Oct 16, shown date-only because product-specific settlement clocks differ. Weekly contract expirations are omitted without an inspected date-specific contract list.
  • Unmatched CARTS, NFCI, Board discussions, industrial production and expiration labels are provisional Medium and reviewed; notes remain visible. Unscheduled geopolitical, trade-policy and supply risks belong in Watch; no verified timed catalyst or current causal news claim is invented.
  • No BEA release is scheduled inside this window. Market quotes are single-source and delayed; observation dates are explicit.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
ES is up 0.30% overnight after SPY fell 0.42% in the cash session; Treasury yields and MOVE eased while VIX rose. That mixed picture favors confirmation over a directional assumption. Treat 10 AM sentiment and inflation expectations as the main verified macro window today. This is a scenario framework, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a break of its observed overnight range with confirming yield/volatility repricing, or sentiment materially changes the growth/inflation balance. No unverified range levels or price targets are supplied. Account for the Oct 12 liquidity holiday and next week's CPI/retail-sales risk.
